description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomLLM class and related functions within the litellm project. It tests various functionalities such as completion, streaming, image generation, embedding, and custom provider registration using pytest and asyncio.

classes.name: CustomModelResponseIterator
classes.description: A custom iterator that parses chunks from a streaming response, both synchronously and asynchronously, within the test environment.

classes.description: A mock implementation of the CustomLLM class used for unit testing various methods like completion, streaming, image generation, and embedding, providing mock responses.
